set.body:
Scheduling lane: film. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Preserved approved film-library scope. Follow S0-S4c order and exact text parity; the earlier annotation preview does not close this ticket.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md docs/plans/2026-09-17-d1a-source-to-story-plan.md §3 S4a.

Every model is still text in this slice; source and SurfaceAtlas stay on the model.

Scope:
story, core, codec, document, fixtures, laws, view, pipeline, docs-site, embed-bench.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Nodes take TypedSupport; overloaded companion applies keep the 54 text construction sites compiling; the 10 copy(support = ...) sites are edited.
2. StoryModel.draft returns Either and checks 'all Text'; the model keeps source and SurfaceAtlas.
3. Node decoders read TypedSupport.Text; text bytes are unchanged.
4. Ordering moves to the text projection; graph-level ordering functions become private[story].
5. The StoryModelUnforgeableSuite probes that Either makes vacuous (copy[Validated], Product) are rewritten, each re-proved on its own clean recompile.
6. The S0 pins are unchanged.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M-L.
set.title: [film] D1A-types S4a: node support becomes TypedSupport; draft becomes fallible
